references.note: Package configuration; may overwrite files, download plugins, or change system settings. Inspect source and preview before applying.

Suppresses macOS update notification banners via user SoftwareUpdate defaults and clears the System Settings update attention badge; pass --with-sudo to also disable system-wide automatic update checks.

macos-setup.effects: Applies the package-specific settings in this script; may write user/system files, fetch plugins, or restart services.

disable-update-notifications.effects: Defers UserNotificationDate and MajorOSUserNotificationDate in com.apple.SoftwareUpdate, disables _SYSTEM_CENTER_:com.apple.SoftwareUpdateNotification in com.apple.ncprefs, disables SoftwareUpdateNotificationManager via launchctl, removes Software Update attention badges from System Settings, optionally disables system-wide automatic update checks when elevated, and restarts notification/Dock services.

DEFER_UNTIL.description: Timestamp passed to UserNotificationDate and MajorOSUserNotificationDate
